node.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 parity chamber has six outer-trace Mobius tests
node.statement: When the normalized c=1 denominator has two antipodal root pairs, there are exactly two source-role patterns. The even canonical outer quartic has unordered ratio trace tau_O=(alpha^2-2gamma)/gamma. Across the three perfect matchings of each source pattern, completion-root PGL matching is equivalent to one of six explicit equations tau_O=4((z+1)/(z-1))^2-2; outer torsion is a 39-step trace recurrence. At harmonic trace -2, two classes are excluded directly, leaving only two symmetry classes. The router does not exclude those classes or the nonharmonic packet.
